query_text: Sign up for a photography course at the community center

messages.content: Sign up for a photography course at the community center

message.content:
I can help you **find** a community-center photography course, but I can’t actually enroll you directly from here. The most relevant option in the results is **Johnson County Community College’s Continuing Education Photography classes**, which include camera basics, creative photography, digital photography, and Photoshop tips, with both face-to-face and online options.[1]

To sign up, use the community center’s registration process and contact the school directly if you need help: JCCC lists **913-469-2323**, with CE office hours **Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.**[1] If you meant a different community center, I can help identify the right course and the exact registration steps.
